evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 indicates the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All four candidate sets (K4_C0001, K4_C0002, K4_C0003, K4_C0004) screen at candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screen does not identify a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral eigengap at the screened resolution for each candidate set.
observations.finding: Leading gaps are largest for K4_C0001 (0.260) and K4_C0002 (0.221), intermediate for K4_C0003 (0.157), and smallest for K4_C0004 (0.108); these describe dominance of the single-cluster resolution rather than internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions within each set.
observations.finding: In every set the gap at resolution 1 is far larger than subsequent gaps (subsequent gaps range from ~4e-05 to ~0.007), consistent with a dominant single-cluster resolution and no prominent higher-resolution gap.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set mean affinities are similar across sets (0.0094–0.0101), with K4_C0004 marginally highest; these are low absolute affinity values and do not by themselves indicate internal subdivision.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their between-set affinity; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: Between-set affinities for the closest pairs are tightly clustered (0.00903–0.00908) and are close to the within-set mean affinities, identifying K4_C0004 as recurrently involved in the nearest pairs; this is a triage signal for possible pair review, not evidence for merging.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in the structural calculation for each set.
observations.finding: Set sizes range from 13 to 39 patients, so structural calculations rest on modest and unequal sample sizes, with K4_C0004 the smallest.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen addresses whether any current candidate shows an obvious internal subdivision signal and which boundaries are relatively close. Within-set mean affinities are low and similar across sets, and the nearest-pair between-set affinities are tightly clustered and close to within-set levels, identifying K4_C0004 as recurrently involved in the closest pairs. These are triage observations about internal structure and boundary proximity; they do not establish retention, split, or merge, and no reclustering was performed.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied, so this report stands alone without prior-report agreement or conflict to integrate.
limitations: Partition-level screening does not provide actual feasible k>=2 internal solutions or their measurements; absence of a subdivision signal here is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinity is a pair-review entry point only and does not support merge conclusions.
Affinity values are low in absolute terms and set sizes are modest and unequal (13–39), limiting precision of the structural estimates.
